_comment: Settings for tools/ballottsr-sync.js. Edit this file (not the script) to teach the parser new names or pollsters.

aliases._comment: normalised ballot name (lowercase, letters+digits only, no u/) -> registry id. Same-name registry siblings (tmf/tmf1) are picked per election automatically.

supersedeNote: Hand-entered snapshots of polls that ballottsr now supplies automatically. Removed on first sync so they are not double counted.

knownDiscrepancies.class7-2026-09: ballottsr's raw count still includes one fraudulent ballot that was removed from the official result; the hand-curated file is correct.
